程序包 model

类 ApplicationRecord

java.lang.Object
model.ApplicationRecord
public class ApplicationRecord extends Object
Represents a TA's application for a job.

Tracks the application ID, the job, the applicant (TA), the current status, the submission time, and an optional rejection reason.

  • 构造器详细资料

    • ApplicationRecord

      public ApplicationRecord(String appId, String jobId, String taId, String status, String appliedAt)
      Creates an application with no reject reason (default "").
      参数:
      appId - unique application ID
      jobId - the job applied for
      taId - the TA who applied
      status - initial status (usually "Pending")
      appliedAt - timestamp when applied (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss)

    • ApplicationRecord

      public ApplicationRecord(String appId, String jobId, String taId, String status, String appliedAt, String rejectReason)
      Creates an application with a reject reason.
      参数:
      appId - unique application ID
      jobId - the job applied for
      taId - the TA who applied
      status - current status
      appliedAt - timestamp when applied
      rejectReason - why the application was rejected (may be empty)

      public String toCsvLine()
      Formats this application as a CSV line.

      Replaces commas and newlines in the reject reason so the line remains valid.

      返回:
